connexion.intro: Sign in to reach your workspace.

inscription.intro: Create your account to reach the application.
inscription.loginAide: It cannot be changed once the account exists.
inscription.desactiveeExplication: Accounts are created by your administrator. Contact them to get access.

oubli.intro: Enter your email address. We will send you a link to set a new password.
oubli.envoye: If an account matches this address, a reset link has just been sent.
oubli.delai: The link is valid for one hour and can only be used once. Remember to check your spam folder.
oubli.indisponible: Contact your administrator to reset your password.
oubli.indisponibleExplication: Automatic email delivery is not enabled on this instance.

reinitialisation.intro: Choose a password for the account below.
reinitialisation.expireExplication: Links stay valid for one hour only. Request a new one to continue.
reinitialisation.utilise: This reset link has already been used.
reinitialisation.utiliseExplication: Your password has already been changed. Sign in with the new one.
reinitialisation.invalide: This reset link is not valid.
reinitialisation.invalideExplication: Your mail client may have truncated it. Copy the whole link from the email, or request a new one.

impose.obligatoire: This step is required before you can use the application.

motif.premiere: Your account was created with a temporary password. Choose your own before continuing.
motif.admin: An administrator reset your password on {{date}}. Set a new one before continuing.

erreurs.compteVerrouille: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again later.
erreurs.nouveauIdentique: The new password must differ from the current one
erreurs.emailDejaPris: This email is already in use
erreurs.domaineNonAutorise: Sign-up is limited to approved email domains
erreurs.inscriptionDesactivee: Self-service account creation is turned off.
erreurs.jetonDejaUtilise: This reset link has already been used.
erreurs.jetonInvalide: This reset link is not valid.
